Name: Boarding House to Npc adventures
Author: andril11
Description:
[center][size=4]This is a Content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]Npc adventures[/url]﻿﻿ that make Sheila and Gregory a full companion![/size][/center]

[center][size=5][i]
This is Sheila[/i][i]![/i][/size]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/729077872161193984/Sheila_portrait.png[/img]﻿
[size=4][b]Sheila is a happy girl that will help you in your advenure! She is a good forager and she is very lucky and energy! (She gives you +3 lucky and +2 speed)[/b]
[/size]
[u]﻿
[/u][size=5][i]This is Gregory!
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/729078443316084836/Gregory_portrait.png[/img]﻿[/i][/size]
[b][size=4]Gregory is an great warrior with the experience of the mines! He is an excelent fighter and has some real endurance! (He gives you +5 defense +3 attack) [/size]
[/b][/center][b]
[/b]
[size=6][center] [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/729080741220188190/Sem_titulo.png[/img]﻿[/center][/size][center][list=1]
